open.ping.title: Signature self-check
open.ping.description: Signature self-check: once the signature verifies, returns the AppKey, the credential owner and the server time. Callable only with requests signed by an open API credential (X-Access-Key, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce, X-Content-Sign, X-Signature).
open.echo.title: Echo request
open.echo.description: Echo: returns the request body as received, to check the content signature and encryption (the body may be AES-CBC encrypted, and the response is then encrypted too). Signed calls only.
openplatform.signing.timestamp_expired: The request is outside the time window (more than {seconds} seconds from the server time).
openplatform.signing.access_key_invalid: The AccessKey is invalid or disabled.
openplatform.signing.ip_not_allowed: The request IP is not on the allow-list: {ip}.
openplatform.signing.content_sign_mismat: The content signature does not match.
openplatform.signing.signature_mismatch: The request signature does not match.
openplatform.signing.algorithm_mismatch: Signature algorithm {value} does not match the configured {expected}.
openplatform.signing.body_too_large: The request body exceeds the limit ({max} bytes).
openplatform.signing.body_decrypt_failed: The request body could not be decrypted.
oauth_apps.list.title: List OAuth apps
oauth_apps.list.description: List OAuth apps (created by the platform or by users under My apps) page by page; the keyword matches name, description, ClientId, homepage and remark, with filters for app type, client type, enabled, skip consent and personal apps.
oauth_apps.get.title: Get OAuth app
oauth_apps.get.description: Get one OAuth app (the secret is never shown).
oauth_apps.create.title: Create OAuth app
oauth_apps.create.description: Create an OAuth app: the ClientId is generated when omitted and is globally unique; a confidential client’s secret is returned this once only, a public client has none (its authorization codes need PKCE).
oauth_apps.update.title: Update OAuth app
oauth_apps.update.description: Update an OAuth app (replaced as a whole, including enabled; the ClientId, client type and secret stay).
oauth_apps.reset_secret.title: Reset OAuth app secret
oauth_apps.reset_secret.description: Reset an OAuth app’s secret: the old secret stops working at once and the new one is returned this once only; public clients have no secret.
oauth_apps.delete.title: Delete OAuth apps
oauth_apps.delete.description: Delete OAuth apps in bulk (soft delete; tokens issued to them stop working with them).
my_oauth_apps.list.title: List my OAuth apps
my_oauth_apps.get.title: Get my OAuth app
my_oauth_apps.get.description: Get one of your OAuth apps.
my_oauth_apps.create.title: Create my OAuth app
my_oauth_apps.create.description: Create one of your OAuth apps (authorization code and refresh token, scopes openid profile email, consent required); a confidential client’s secret is returned this once only. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_oauth_apps.update.title: Update my OAuth app
my_oauth_apps.update.description: Update one of your OAuth apps: name, homepage, description, redirect URIs, logo and enabled. Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_oauth_apps.reset_secret.title: Reset my OAuth app secret
my_oauth_apps.reset_secret.description: Reset the secret of one of your OAuth apps (public clients have none). Not available in impersonation sessions.
my_oauth_apps.delete.title: Delete my OAuth apps
my_oauth_apps.delete.description: Delete your OAuth apps. Not available in impersonation sessions.
openplatform.query.filter_unsupported: Filtering by {field} with {operator} is not supported.
openplatform.oauth_apps.not_found: The OAuth app does not exist.
openplatform.oauth_apps.public_client_no: Public clients do not use a secret, so it cannot be reset.
openplatform.oauth_apps.client_id_invali: The ClientId must be 3 to 100 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens: {value}.
openplatform.oauth_apps.grant_type_unsup: Unsupported grant type: {value} (authorization_code is required, refresh_token is optional).
openplatform.oauth_apps.scope_unsupporte: Unsupported scope: {value} (openid is required; profile, email and phone are optional).
openplatform.oauth_apps.redirect_uri_inv: Invalid redirect URI: {value} (1 to 10 absolute URIs without #; http only for loopback).
openplatform.oauth_apps.url_invalid: The URL must be http or https: {value}.
oauth_consents.resolve.title: Preview authorization request
oauth_consents.resolve.description: Preview for the consent page: checks the authorization request (client, redirect URI, response_type, PKCE, scopes) and returns the app, the scopes and whether consent can be skipped. Not available in impersonation sessions.
oauth_consents.approve.title: Approve authorization
oauth_consents.approve.description: Approve the authorization: issues an authorization code, records the consent and returns the redirect URI with code and state. Not available in impersonation sessions.
oauth_consents.deny.title: Deny authorization
oauth_consents.deny.description: Deny the authorization: returns the redirect URI with error=access_denied and state, only when the client and redirect URI are valid.
oauth_consents.list.title: List authorized apps
oauth_consents.list.description: List the apps you have authorized and the scopes you granted.
oauth_consents.revoke.title: Revoke app authorization
oauth_consents.revoke.description: Revoke your authorization of an app: deletes the consent and revokes all of your tokens it holds. Not available in impersonation sessions.
openplatform.oauth_consents.not_found: You have not authorized this app: {clientId}.

jobs.openplatform.oauth_cleanup.title: Clean up expired OAuth grants
jobs.openplatform.oauth_cleanup.descript: Delete authorization codes expired for a day and tokens expired for seven days.
